items.title: SLB Shares Climb 4.2% After Venezuela Data Agreement, Analysts Remain 8% Above Consensus
items.summary: SLB stock rose 4.2% after securing a new data agreement with Venezuela's PDVSA, gaining access to critical oilfield data and production monitoring. Despite the gains, analysts maintain a consensus target of $61.93, suggesting an 8.03% potential upside from its closing price of $57.33. The deal's financial terms are undisclosed, and risks include payment delays and geopolitical factors, although SLB's strong second-quarter revenue of $8.97 billion and positive regional growth offer a solid operational foundation.

items.title: Dollar Tree Says Higher Fuel Prices Are Becoming a ‘Very, Very Meaningful’ Headwind
items.summary: Dollar Tree reported strong second-quarter results, with adjusted diluted earnings of $2.70 per share, including a significant benefit from tariff refunds, and sales rising 7% to $4.89 billion. However, the company's CFO warned that higher fuel prices are creating a "very, very meaningful" headwind, leading to increased freight surcharges and an expected decline in fourth-quarter gross margin. Despite this, Dollar Tree raised its fiscal 2026 adjusted earnings outlook but maintained its annual sales forecast.

items.title: Flputnam Investment Management Co. Decreases Stock Holdings in Lam Research Corporation $LRCX
items.summary: Flputnam Investment Management Co. reduced its stake in Lam Research Corporation by 24% in Q2, selling 92,333 shares but still holding 292,741 shares valued at $126.9 million. Despite this reduction and recent insider selling, institutional investors collectively own 84.61% of the company, and analysts maintain a "Moderate Buy" rating with an average target price of $357.31. Lam Research exceeded Q2 earnings expectations, increased its dividend by 27%, and is investing $3 billion in a new AI semiconductor lab, though concerns over U.S.-China trade relations and tariffs persist.

items.title: General Motors (GM) Stock May Still Look Like A Bargain After Brake Probe
items.summary: General Motors (GM) stock presents a mixed valuation picture: a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis suggests it is undervalued by 37.6% at $138 per share compared to its current $86.27, yet its P/E ratio of 40.8x indicates it is overvalued relative to the auto industry and peers. This discrepancy reflects solid cash flow prospects against market concerns over a federal brake investigation and potential tariffs. The article concludes that while the DCF points to upside, broader valuation checks are weak, suggesting GM is not a straightforward bargain.

items.title: Think Six Months Ahead
items.summary: Torsten Slok, Apollo's Chief Economist, discusses the future of long-term interest rates, predicting they could be significantly lower in six months due to the impact of Artificial Intelligence. He explains that both the success of AI, leading to deflation, and the failure of AI, causing a market bubble burst and a flight to safety, would drive rates down. The article emphasizes that financial markets are driven by narratives, and the AI narrative will dominate the discussion around rates in early 2027.
